description: This is a test source file for the AppListItems component in an Android project, containing unit tests for app listing, search, sorting, and repository filtering functionalities.

classes.name: AppListItemsTest
classes.description: A test class for verifying app listing, search, sorting, and filtering functionalities in an Android app.

methods.name: testSearchQuery
methods.description: Tests the search functionality with various queries and verifies correct app retrieval and sorting.

methods.name: testSearchQueryInCategory
methods.description: Tests search within specific categories and verifies filtering and sorting.

methods.name: testSearchQueryPerRepo
methods.description: Tests search within specific repositories and verifies filtering and sorting.

methods.name: testMalformedSearchQuery
methods.description: Tests handling of malformed search queries.

methods.name: testSortOrderByLastUpdated
methods.description: Verifies sorting of apps by last updated timestamp.

methods.name: testSortOrderByName
methods.description: Verifies sorting of apps by name.

methods.name: testPackageManagerInfo
methods.description: Checks that installed package info is correctly reflected in app list items.

methods.name: testCompatibility
methods.description: Tests app compatibility status based on version data.

methods.name: testAntiFeaturesFromHighestVersion
methods.description: Verifies anti-features are derived from the highest version of an app.

methods.name: testOnlyFromEnabledRepos
methods.description: Ensures only apps from enabled repositories are listed.

methods.name: testFromRepoWithHighestWeight
methods.description: Checks that apps are selected from repositories with the highest weight.

methods.name: testFromRepoFromAppPrefs
methods.description: Verifies app selection based on user repository preferences.

methods.name: testOnlyFromGivenCategories
methods.description: Tests filtering apps by specific categories.

methods.name: testGetInstalledAppListItems
methods.description: Tests retrieval of installed apps based on PackageManager info.

methods.name: testGetInstalledAppListItemsFlow
methods.description: Tests reactive flow of installed app list items.

methods.name: testGetInstalledAppListItemsMaxVars
methods.description: Checks handling of maximum variable limits in queries for installed apps.

methods.name: testGetInstalledAppListItemsFlowMaxVars
methods.description: Tests reactive flow with maximum variable limits.

methods.name: testAuthor_NoApp
methods.description: Tests author-related functions when no apps are associated.

methods.name: testAuthor_OneApp
methods.description: Tests author functions with a single app.

methods.name: testAuthor_TwoApps
methods.description: Tests author functions with two apps.

methods.name: testAuthor_MultipleApps
methods.description: Tests author functions with multiple apps.

methods.name: testHasAuthorMoreThanOneApp_OneAppDifferentRepos
methods.description: Verifies author app count when apps are in different repositories.

methods.name: testHasAuthorMoreThanOneApp_TwoAppsDifferentRepos
methods.description: Verifies author app count with two apps in different repositories.

methods.name: getItems
methods.description: Helper function to run tests on various getAppListItems methods.

methods.name: assertEquals
methods.description: Asserts equality between expected MetadataV2 and AppListItem.
